reviews.text: Good game with a good foundation. A lot of the perks kinda felt underwhelming as there are only really a handful that make you feel powerful. Weapon upgrading was also a little underpowered considering the cost investment in it. The two biggest upgrades I would like to see is a focus on movement, as right now you'll lose to bosses being caught in a reload/health usage - a simple fix here would be to cancel those animations in favor of a dodge, jump, or sprint. The last upgrade is please make the kick able to open supply creates instead of braking them. My first run I was convinced the game was stingy on health and ammo but it was only because I used my foot to open creates and cacoons instead of the melee weapon. But I really enjoyed the game. Also gad damn that cake!

Very slow, very easy. Looks nice and I like the boss with the huge butt - they're cool and so is their huge butt, but the game is just SO slow. I've played a lot of FPS roguelites for a lot of time, and this just ain't it. Doing anything is slow, guns shoot slow, augments don't really change that much in a run, it's just one of those games that I can't find something specific and interesting that it does that makes me want to come back to it. In games of the same genre you typically have a class, and then modifiers in the run for the classes, in this you can only run, roll, or jump, so all of the "run changers" are often something like "do more damage when jumping", or the super exciting "stand still for 2 seconds to do more damage". Perma upgrade tree has standard "more hp" or "more stamina" and is huge, but with nothing particularly exciting past the standard stat upgrades that make me want to chip away at it - mainly because each HP and stamina node needs upgrading 5 times before it'll let you move on to something less boring. So long resources, hello boring grind! It's a weird one, because despite being slow paced, it doesn't lean into this to create any exciting combat situations. It reminds me a lot of Deadzone Rogue, another slow paced game with almost no verticality, and enemies that just walk at you menacingly while you backpedal and rarely take damage. If I wasn't so well versed in the genre I'm sure it would scratch that itch, but it is certainly too little too late for me.

I'll start by saying it's not awful, but it's definitely not worth the €24.50 discount (€19.60). Many features are broken in co-op, and it's generally impossible to complete due to glitches or bugs. We've found ourselves throwing away runs because melee weapons can't be picked up, and when you try, the equipped one breaks. Or the game crashes during boss fights. Many other things, like weapons or upgrades, are bland; there's nothing distinctive about them. I wouldn't advise against it, but I'd recommend getting it at a lower price.

[h1]总评：B+（平淡普通）[/h1] 美术设计： ☐ 看了想吐 ☐ 同一个妈生的 ☐ 中规中矩 ☑ 视觉享受 ☐ 极致艺术 氛围塑造： ☐ 键鼠操作平台 ☑ 略有代入感 ☐ 知道在玩游戏 ☐ 极具沉浸感 ☐ 已置身于游戏世界了 游戏性： ☐ 上班牛马 ☑ 普通游戏 ☐ 有精彩处 ☐ 非常优秀 ☐ 年度游戏 BOSS设计： ☐ 普通杂兵 ☑ 动作单一 ☐ 稍有挑战 ☐ 招式华丽 ☐ 黑暗之魂 战斗难度： ☐ 有手就行 ☐ 简单亲民 ☑ 难度适中 ☐ 会让你红温 ☐ 近乎不可能 音乐/音效： ☐ 耳朵流血 ☑ 尚可接受 ☐ 好坏参半 ☐ 天籁之音 ☐ 妈妈我飞起来了 剧情/设定： ☐ 可有可无 ☑ 俗套乏味 ☐ 见仁见智 ☐ 独一无二 ☐ 震撼至极 买入价格建议： ☑ 50%以上再考虑 ☐ 等史低促销 ☐ 打折了就入 ☐ 不打折都划算 ☐ 倒贴钱我都愿意 ------------------------------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------ [h1] 《毁灭协议》评价：大问题不多，但小问题多到到足以让人丧失乐趣 [/h1] 相信买这游戏的人基本都是冲着画风来的，这游戏的视觉质量可以说是相当不错，各种怪物的3D模型都极为独特且富有质感，各种弱点的位置也被设计得相当巧妙，且与怪物的整体美术设计契合。怪物被击中后产生的血溅效果也很养眼。 也正因为这个游戏华丽的外表，内核的贫乏才会令我感到痛心，这款游戏显然又是把抢先体验版当成正式版发布了。先说说这该死的bug以及优化问题吧，很多时候都会有各种各样的模型碰撞错误问题，导致道具或者怪物甚至自己都有概率被墙壁或障碍物卡住。道具被卡可以当一开始就没有这个道具，但要是怪物被卡或者自己被卡，你将会陷入要么打不着怪物要么自己动不了的尴尬处境，恭喜你前面全部白打，快速重开吧；另外这游戏每次进入一个新的房间都会有莫名其妙的卡顿，平时也会有时不时的丢帧，而FPS玩家们都知道帧率这玩意有多么影响游戏体验。 不过运气好一点的话玩家还是能顺顺利利走完一局的，但这游戏安排中的小错误多到难以想象。敌人的攻击是单调的，武器的种类是稀少的，build设计是基本堆砌数值的，击中判定是很随缘的（在盾哥这种恶心怪物身上尤其明显），技能树是很没深度的，钱是永远不够的，隐藏房是需要耗血试错的，且就算找到了奖励也很少，房间类型也是很单调的，且房间间的传送是没有的（为啥要把传送去掉啊，没有这玩意要多跑多少路开发知道吗）。另外游戏将"关卡"切割成三个段落，而每段都结束得过于仓促——往往在你刚开始感受到成长数值带来的乐趣与爽感时，进程就戛然而止。 当然，要说这游戏一点闪光点都没有就是尬黑了。我特别喜欢房间中散布的各种各样可以打碎的小玩意，打碎解压的同时还能获取资源，并且有些还需要仔细观察或者跑酷才能够着；另外地图中散布着许多爆炸物以及毒雾囊，算是加入了一些策略元素。同时这游戏boss的设计也算刚到及格线，尽管仍旧存在招式单一的问题导致大部分都是初见杀后就攻击模式就基本摸透了，但起码没小怪那么明显，这游戏的美术也占了很大一部分功劳（不过还是得批评一下第二扇区第一个boss，能够把多阶段与缩头无敌怪合在一起，外加上毫无观赏性的攻击，整场战斗只有烦躁） 在层出不穷的漏洞、海量平庸的升级选项和糟糕的进度设计之间，其实隐藏着一部杰作的雏形。只能说这游戏开发要打的补丁可多着呢。 最后吐糟一下花40个小时把这游戏白金了的我自己，真的棒极了！

I can't wait to go spend my metacurrency on 5% run speed in the tech tree. Oh boy. I loved this game in the playtest/demo, but the release just did not improve on the issues. Passives/augments feel useless or way too punishing (turning your pistol into a shotgun with spray pattern for instance.) You can get the same weapon in a box that you have in your hand. I've had no desire to get anything other than a high damage weapon because the amount of 50%+ damage upgrades make fast firing ones feel useless in comparison. One tap enemies in their weak spot or do subpar damage when every second means you might get hit. Wonder which one I prefer. Skill tree is incredibly underwhelming. It's like they took a vampire survivor's upgrade system (damage, hp, movement speed, etc.) and just decided... let's make it into a tree. The most underwhelming upgrades are in it that you could probably not even touch it and still have a fine experience. 1% damage increases, 5% sprint speed (you won't be sprinting most of the time), probably the only worthwhile upgrades are hp/stamina related. Everything else is forgettable. Enemy balance is all over the place. I only dodged when facing the boss. Bosses do like 25 damage per attack so they're the only threat. Basic enemies barely have any animation and it feels like all the animation budget went into the sexy robot girl. Which I do like looking at don't get me wrong, but the regular enemies are just kinda eh.

I have absolutely no idea how this game gets quite a few positive reviews. This might be the worst "gaming product" I touched in a VERY long time. Softlocks are everywhere. Bugs in code logic are insane. Every element of the game design is made by inexperienced middle-schoolers who never played a game in their lives, just sat next to a big brother playing Binding Of Isaac and some similar projects. Here are some examples of what I am talking about in no particular order of significance: - You can fall down between crates randomly and not able to get out of the pit; however when you're doing some challenges there are invisible walls which prevent you from jumping correctly. Great. - Take an augment of HP+x, doesn't matter how much; then take glass cannon augment; then try to unequip HP+x. You insta-die. Especially funny in the multiplayer, when you are getting stuck in a death loop if you're being revived. Possible to slowly move cursor to the item in the inventory and right click to mitigate this, but it's not super easy to do, check for yourself. - In multiplayer when one player leaves the area too quickly the second one just falls through the prematurely-unloaded textures. - When you die in multi, you're staring at a death screen (grey background and "waiting for resurrection") instead of spectating another player - Map doesn't show enemy positions, arrows in the UI are absolutely unusable, you can randomly get attacked from any direction, especially when enemy spawns right behind you for no reason - Entering some areas you're getting enemies directly in your face at the entrance - Enemy types and placement is very questionable in some areas, especially very narrow ones The list goes on. This game is not worth neither your time nor your money, how can this be priced 25 EUR is beyond any reason. If I didn't buy the key outside steam it would be an instant refund, but oh well.

入手这款游戏二小时后，我确信自己只是在重复给一个精致的框架付费。表面上它有肉鸽该有的一切：随机道具、天赋树、逐渐解锁的内容——但所有这些都散发着浓浓的“配方感”。每次开局不是惊喜，而是“又是这个流派，又是那把武器，又是那几种排列组合”。 最致命的是，它的随机性毫无灵魂。平衡性像用Excel算出来的：拿到关键道具就碾压，缺了核心组件就坐牢。怪物只是换皮的血包，关卡只是拼贴的模板，所谓的“Build构筑”不过是把明显该凑在一起的词条硬凑一遍。玩到第三小时我就看到了游戏的全部底牌，剩下的只是机械地刷解锁进度。狗屎 更让人疲惫的是那些故作深沉的碎片化叙事。在重复了三十次差不多的流程后，谁还会在意背景故事里那几句谜语人台词？肉鸽游戏的灵魂应该是“每次都不一样的心跳”，但这里只有“每次都很一样的流水账”。 恕我直言，这根本不是roguelike，这是rogue皮肤的概率模拟器。Steam上越来越多的肉鸽游戏就像用同一套模具压出来的饼干，换点糖霜就敢卖。求求开发者们：做点真正的设计，而不是把创意外包给随机数生成器。

It's OK. I played a couple of runs, got to what I assume is the last boss of stage 1 (based on the map) on my second which felt a little easy. The gameplay is pretty fun, weapons are quite diverse and feel good to use, nice impact to everything. The visuals get old fast, every level looks the same and although there is a dripfeed of new enemies the same ones you've been fighting since floor 1 keep coming along too (and getting easier and easier to kill, of course). The boss killed me because I made a poor decision but I was very close to taking it out on my second try which for this kind of game seems crazy. A lot of the pickups just feel a bit pointless: at no point was I short on ammo, even though I stuck to one ammo type basically the whole time; I had enough keycards to open every door without even thinking about it, and half a dozen to spare most of the time; I found some good augments early but they just keep coming and since you can only slot a few (I assume you can later slot more, but, second run...) I just kept the good ones slotted and after a while didn't even bother picking new ones up. IT doesn't help that there's no real progression to the way things drop, on floor 4/5 I got a LOWER level version of the gun I found on floor 2. Once you visit a weapon upgrade vendor your high level gun will just be better than everything else you find. By floor 6 I was just running through to the exit. And Jocaste.... Whyyyyy in a fairly gruesome and gritty game am I looking at a ridiculous sexed up anime girl shaking her ass at me? Just completely took me out of the game. I have no real desire to go back to it after my 2 attempts.

Can't recommend this game in it's current state. I came in thinking this would be a nice Doom+Gunfire Reborn/Roboquest clone. I played my first and only run reaching the end and beating the 3 bosses with relatively no issue. Here are the pros and cons: Pros: -Aestheticly interesting. The look and feel is relatively unique and the gameplay is smooth. -Interesting level structure. Hidden rooms that cost HP to look for, challenge rooms (parkour) and hackable chests and doors for more loot. -Augment system to modify weapons and character. Augments are particular for melee, energy and physical ranged weapons which is a good start. Cons: -Plain and simple. The game is too easy. -The first run's bosses (even the secret boss) have very similar move and attack structures. It goes something like... rush player with melee, ranged scatter attack, ranged attack, aoe, repeat. The attacks are easy to predict after the first or second cycle. -Enemies are very basic and slow. You rarely are in a position of being overwhelmed or caught off guard. The enemies move at a crawl and you can easily run off to the other side of the room and pick them off. -The variety of enemies is pretty disappointing as they mostly split between exploding enemies, melee enemies and basic ranged enemies.

i enjoyed my time with it, but i can see why some people wouldn't. it's a fps roguelite, but i'm scratching my head at the [i]why[/i] of it. the game is a full campaign split into three acts, each having to be completed in one go, and a death sends you all the way back. you only get your checkpoints at each end of act. i don't have a problem with this, but the roguelite elements almost feel like it's... tacked on? there is meta-progression. it looks like a lot but 90% of it are just 'more numbers' stuff. you get extra augment slots too but a lot of augments are also more numbers stuff. you put in the effort into getting all these upgrades and they don't feel like they alter your gameplay much, if at all. there are a lot of weapons, all visually different - i can commend that for sure - but they also don't feel like they mix things up. i've also noticed that weapons that do splash damage (like grenade launcher, laser cannon) are just Simply Better. they ignore shields, hits in aoe, acceptable reload time, high base damage that can be heavily and easily buffed by augments. who cares that they can't hit weak points they're all dead lol. all that being said, my biggest confusion to this game being roguelite is that, and this is going to make me sound like a gamer dudebro snob, but it's really just not that difficult. i was done with the final boss long before getting all the upgrades, which took a little more than 10 hours, and i found out there are some augments i didn't unlock, [i]because i wasn't dying enough[/i]. the git is too gud that i now have to put in extra effort to get those unlocks??? the 'soulslike boss fights' on their steam page almost feels like false advertisement, because these bosses were really, really, and i really mean really, easy. they have maybe 3 moves at best, and they're all heavily telegraphed. and they do the thing i loathe the most in a 'soulslike' game where the boss would just do its own thing and i get to just literally sit there and watch and wait for them to be done and out of invuln so i can keep fighting them before it's a non-mechanic that i can just hold strafe and avoid. and i know that this is the devs' darling, but jocaste...... pardon the comparison it's who she reminds me of, but she's like gabriel ultrakill, without an ounce of aura, both in plot and in combat. i guess i can give them something because each encounter she gets different moves, but that's where it ends. she's just way too much of a pushover for how much they prop her up to be this badass warrior. (i'm sorry i'm just very gay so the Assets aren't enough to convince me.) the game looks pretty though. and i liked the music during combat sequences. it sounds like i hated it but honest to god i did have fun. if the campaign were to be any longer than it currently is i'd rag on it harder. i wouldn't get this at anything lower than a 40% discount though, not enough content to really justify it. recommending this because i want to see where the devs go from here.

I would not recommend the game in the current state due to its numerous bugs that make us lose the game on co-op. Such as getting softlocked in a bossfight, because the host died on an unreachable spot, is waiting for a revival and the boss does not progress. Or that the controls gets stuck in a way that we get unable to fire without first switching to another weapon. Even minor things like having the skip lore sequence icon shown on the UI during a level. My friend who plays on a gamepad said that it does not even reconnect it properly when he loses it for a while. The last time the controls even got stuck so badly for him that he could neither fire nor switch weapons anymore during a bossfight, so we lost again. I probably would change the review to positive if it gets fixes, because the game is quite okay-ish and kinda fun, but as of now we agreed to play something else until some more fixes roll out.
